note: Sixteen beats over FOUR paid stills, two free reuses of a clip's own last frame, and exactly ONE generated beat capped at the 4s a clip actually lasts. A beat names the WORD or phrase it starts on and ends when the next begins, so the song sets every length and no cut is authored by hand. Counting beats anchor to the sung number, because 'four, then three, then two' changes the count three times inside one line and a line-level anchor would hold the first number through all of it. Pictures are REUSED with different framing where the lyric returns to the same idea. The window is one bought picture; the star COUNT is drawn deterministically on top, so five really is five and the same five never move.
